goal: A Python CLI tool (RepoHealth) that authenticates via GitHub token, fetches all repos in an org/user, fetches issues/PRs, filters by age (>30 days) and status, and outputs a formatted Markdown/ASCII report. Can optionally generate a shell script to batch-close or label stale items.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticate via GitHub token (env var or CLI arg)
Fetch all repos for a specified org/user
Fetch issues and PRs across repos
